title: Global Series Jiang Yanggu & Mu Yanling: card flavor text
storyline: Global Series Jiang Yanggu & Mu Yanling

entities.name: Jiang Yanggu
entities.description: A planeswalker who writes a travelogue about the Arrow Bamboo Forest and its beasts; he came to the forest and drove back the fierce zheng.

entities.name: Mu Yanling
entities.description: A planeswalker who keeps a journal and notes a mortal blessed with Qilin's essence.

entities.name: Yinglong
entities.description: The Ancestor Dragon, said to have given birth to the qilin and the phoenix and, after them, all hairy and winged beings.

entities.name: Mowu
entities.description: A creature that was wary on the day Jiang Yanggu's travelogue records, as though it sensed danger ahead.

entities.name: Arrow Bamboo Forest
entities.description: A forest whose welcoming appearance masks deathly hostility, home to pangolins and agitated herds.

entities.name: Great Lake of Cloud Dream
entities.description: A great lake over which a rainbow is seen after the rain.

entities.name: Northern Mountains
entities.description: Mountains deep within which the yaks linger silently.

entities.name: Mount Zhaoyao
entities.description: A forest of stones reaching the clouds near the Western Seas, a land of wondrous treasures and strange animals.

entities.name: Western Seas
entities.description: Seas near which Mount Zhaoyao lies.

events.summary: Jiang Yanggu came to the Arrow Bamboo Forest, after which few of the fierce zheng survived.
events.quote: Few survived before Jiang Yanggu came.

events.summary: Jiang Yanggu records in his travelogue that the Ancestor Dragon appeared atop the clouds amid shattering mountains.
events.quote: "The Ancestor Dragon appeared atop the clouds, amid shattering mountains and sundering earth."

events.summary: Mu Yanling notes in her journal that a mortal seems to have been blessed with Qilin's essence.
events.quote: "Interesting . . . This mortal being seems to have been blessed with Qilin's essence."
